notes: Valencia's AI landing page (valenciacollege.edu/artificial-intelligence -> myvc.valenciacollege.edu/pages/artificial-intelligence-landing-page) and Presidential Commission summary-document are JavaScript-only single-page apps; curl and WebFetch returned an empty shell, so they are inaccessible by the supported routes (fetched text is 8 chars, not saved as a document).
